name: One multi-holding household receives only one active notice

statusDetails.message: With three group 9 holdings for 12 and an eligible waiter, two evaluations produced one active notice for 12 with no selected holding.

labels.value: Scarcity notice on a standing holding

labels.value: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household

steps.name: Given one household holds three standing slots in a full eligible group
And an eligible household is waiting in that group
When scarcity is evaluated twice before the first notice lapses
Then only one notice is active for that multi-holding household
And no second holding is selected for loss by the repeated evaluation
